title: Segmented control
description: Small single-choice filter sets shown in full (2–5 values, often with tabular-nums counts): a `raised` track (h32, radius 8, padding 4, gap 4) with h24 items (12px/600) and one solid `raised-2` pill (white in light theme) sliding in 300ms ease-out.
when: 2–5 filter values shown in full, often with counts (Tất cả · Đang mở · Đang báo giá · Đã chốt).
Leading view switch of a FilterChipRow (`leading`) when a list splits into a few status slices.

instead.need: 5+ sections of a page, or sections with icons (settings-like pages)
2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page
Facet filters (supplier, owner, date, multiple active at once)
List ↔ grid and density icon toggles

a11y: WAI-ARIA radiogroup / radio with aria-checked and roving tabindex; ←/→, ↑/↓, Home and End.
activation="manual" moves focus with arrows and selects on Enter or Space; onBeforeChange can refuse a switch.
Scrolls sideways on phones with a 2px edge cue and keeps the active segment in view; sliding and fades turn off under prefers-reduced-motion.
notes: When to use which: PillTabs for 5+ sections or sections with icons · SegmentedControl for 2–5 filter values shown in full with counts · TextTabs for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page · FilterChipRow for filters.

examples.title: Manual activation, guard and narrow scroll
